entries.title: TradingView chart widgets and market overview components
entries.claim_supported: TradingView documents embeddable chart, symbol overview, mini chart, market summary and market overview widgets for use on external websites.
observations: Embeddable financial widgets are an established distribution pattern.
A widget can extend an existing publisher's site while linking users to a third-party market-data product.
limitations: This documents a competitor capability, not evidence that AstroCrown has permission to redistribute TradingView or other provider data.
A familiar embed format is not itself a distinctive advantage.
The source is official product documentation, not independent proof of performance or adoption impact.
entries.license_note: Review current widget terms, attribution requirements, data licensing and commercial conditions before any integration.

entries.title: TradingView widget integration formats and onboarding
entries.claim_supported: TradingView documents widgets supplied as HTML snippets or React components with built-in data, and describes charts, tickers, calendars and watchlists as embeddable components.
observations: Embedded market components can be delivered through standard web integration patterns.
Widget data-source and redistribution terms are separate from the technical embedding mechanism.
limitations: Marketing and integration documentation does not independently establish usage or conversion outcomes.
AstroCrown should build its own intellectual value rather than assuming a widget library is differentiating.
entries.license_note: No adoption or redistribution permission is inferred from the existence of the documentation.

entries.title: Bitquery AI on-chain investigations
entries.claim_supported: Bitquery publicly describes an AI investigation product for blockchain questions, fund tracing, wallet attribution, multichain analysis, visualisations and reports with linked transaction evidence, confidence and caveats.
observations: AI-assisted blockchain investigation and auditable reporting already exist in the market.
The vendor describes alternative tracing methodologies and second-opinion review as product capabilities.
limitations: This is vendor-published product material and is not independent verification of the advertised accuracy or coverage.
AstroCrown must not claim the broad idea of AI blockchain investigation is unique.
Exact capabilities, pricing, chain coverage and product availability should be rechecked before a competitive decision.
entries.license_note: No software, data or service licence permission is inferred.

entries.title: Nansen AI and on-chain intelligence positioning
entries.claim_supported: Nansen's public homepage markets AI-enabled on-chain intelligence and agentic trading alongside its labelled-wallet data.
observations: AI-enabled on-chain intelligence is already a competitive product direction.
A broad claim that an AI-powered blockchain assistant is new would be unsafe.
limitations: The homepage is marketing material and does not fully specify the current agent capabilities, methodology, supported chains or performance.
A deeper feature-by-feature competitor review is required before approving Living Market Laboratory differentiation.
entries.license_note: No data access, redistribution or commercial rights are inferred.
